name: nominal
note: Deployed 37-foil stopping target under Run1Bap, in the foilsflash environment. Baseline for 'does the optimised target beat deployed'. The 6 knobs are INERT here -- no geometry line references them. Throwaway measurement mode -- DELETE after the A/B lands.

lines.comment: The deployed stack is emitted explicitly below (see next comment) rather than inherited, but the values are the base include's. No IPA compensation: at the deployed 800 mm span the compensation returns the stock 625, so omitting the line IS the right value. Everything else matches the foilsflash environment, so the ONLY difference from a BO eval is the target geometry.

Deployed 37-foil stack written out EXPLICITLY via the base_* consts. Bit-identical to the base include (stoppingTargetHoles_v02 -> _DOE_review_2017: 37 x rOut 75.00, halfThickness 0.0528, holeRadius 21.5); the base deltaZ 22.222222 gives the 800 mm span. Written out so the baseline is self-describing and so preflight's as-built GDML check has a vector to verify -- against an implicit stack it correctly refuses to pass.

POISON PILL, same as every other arm: an unpatched StoppingTargetMaker ignores holeRadii and reads this scalar. 1e6 forces a loud G4Tubs crash instead of a silently uniform stack -- emitting a 'sensible' scalar is how 62 foilsg rows were lost.

EMC_Source relocated 5300 -> 5000. It is a 20um disc of ds.vacuumMaterial (vd.halfLength=0.01) -- ZERO mass, no scattering, no absorption -- and NO foils-family stage reads virtual detectors (only pot_only instantiates ReadVirtualDetector). At 5300 it was the UPSTREAM wall of the zero-overlap corridor, capping the stack at 6271-5300=971mm. zEMCSourceInMu2e is a plain c.getDouble default at VirtualDetectorMaker.cc:189, so this is one config line, no source patch. EMC_Source2 stays at 4800, so ordering is preserved.
Degrader parked at 120 deg (mmackenz hardware detent)

TT_MidInner -> DS2Vacuum workaround REMOVED 2026-07-28 (Run1Bap migration). Under v13_12_10 constructVirtualDetectors:502 parented the tracker VDs on `isDumbbell` (always false here), nailing them into DS2Vacuum while Mu2eWorld:346 put the tracker itself in DS3Vacuum -- VDs protruded 1.8-3.5 m outside their mother, GeomMgt0002 fatal. Forcing tracker.inDS2Vacuum=true + ds2.halfLength=3825 made the two agree. v13_32_10 keys VD parenting on !tracker.inDS2Vacuum, so stock is self-consistent and the workaround is not just redundant but harmful: it re-parented EMC_0_Front into DS2Vacuum as a sibling of StoppingTargetMother, which WAS the last remaining overlap. Measured 2x2 on foilspf corner_hi: Run1Bak+override 1 overlap, Run1Bap+override 1, Run1Bak-override 6 + rc=134 core dump, Run1Bap-override 0.
